mule.purpose: Order A drivetrain experiment, not the competition chassis
mule.release_gate: Measure received motor, bracket, hub, wheel and caster; verify fit, screw engagement and support before fabrication.

competition_concept.purpose: Legal-envelope mockup and integrated mission architecture
competition_concept.shape: rectangular conservative baseline; round alternative requires official Q&A
competition_concept.drive: two encoder gearmotors with supports; exact wheel locations and mechanism packaging unresolved
competition_concept.mechanism: passive fork first experiment; guided bore and OD gripper retained for common E04 comparison
competition_concept.release_gate: Confirm envelope interpretation and field clearances; test full-footprint mockup before production CAD.

shared_parameters.status: synthetic scenario values, not measured component ratings

limitations: The shaft-down mule is a CAD-derived proposal, not a measured or selected fabrication revision.
The competition envelope is a conservative concept, not final CAD or proof of legal lap/pit access.
No mass, inertia, friction, current, thermal or battery parameter is physically calibrated.
No mechanism, actuator, driver, battery, charger or final production BOM is released.
